falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the previous 52-week high by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear breakout above a major resistance level would invalidate the current 'HOLD' signal, suggesting a bullish trend rather than a potential blowoff top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume on two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would indicate strong market participation and momentum, contradicting the 'HOLD' signal and suggesting a trend reversal or continuation rather than a blowoff.

falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above the 200-day moving average by 3% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive move above this key long-term trendline would invalidate the current pattern match to a historical top, indicating a shift to a bullish phase instead of a potential decline.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
